decision.bottleneck: Third-pick Ryth has low farming contribution in supplied development losses; source only spends gold at spawn/death.
decision.policy: Replace Ryth with third-pick Tavi; buy the existing staged farming build on ordinary field turns as gold permits; exclude Tavi from gold-only shopping recall, retaining health recovery.
decision.hypothesis: A third-pick Tavi with immediate field reinvestment increases matched wins and mean submitted gems over the edit base without new faults or fuel suspensions.
decision.falsifier: Nonpositive matched win or tribute gain, or new reliability failures.
decision.mechanism_status: Unmeasured rules/source deduction. Loss totals do not establish why Ryth underperformed.
decision.risk: Ranged attack/movement share an allowance, potentially slowing capture entry; Tavi has less starting HP and field Health does not heal. Changed draft may weaken frontline control.
decision.alternatives: Do not repeat unsuccessful generic combat ranking, dash continuation, contact farming, corridor banking or live claims without new causal evidence.
